full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 真实mod注册FluxShield物品/能力。原生Item.use empowered时先repel，只有useEnergy(true,living)成功才按范围排creative/spectator并对Living调用nativeknockback、其他实体normalize后setDeltaMovement/hasImpulse；repel结束后use再hasEnergy(true)，不足返回FAIL，够交父盾use。onUseTick不足releaseUsingItem；原生capability.onBlock也复用repel，不另计。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 计1：实际控制副作用先付费执行，最终持盾准入随后再次验剩余能量的不同门顺序。普通非creative、提取成功且初始恰2000示例可先repel再FAIL，不能用FAIL当控制未发生或Boss拒控。Living原生knockback仍可有外部抗性，非Living走另一直接速度路径；本类没有世界side门，不声称无预测重复。付费不根据目标数量/实际移动成功/伤害回执；无目标也可花费。与MPS hurt true才目标addVelocity、SpellEnginehurt忽略bool后偏移冲量不同，此处根本未调用hurt。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss控制门应包住所有实际控制路径，反馈不能根据物品use结果反推；统一语义原因需要位于真正副作用前，尝试成本和提示节流分开。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: FluxShield/IFlux/IMultiMode全文和注册已读；外部IEnergyContainerItem实际提取/Utils creative实现、ShieldItemCoFH最终父use未展开，限定接口提取成功假设，不把示例当实测。canBlock特殊flux扩展缺CoFH最终消费者，本轮保留支持0。

comparisons.distinction: Old owner prepays one repel before final use-energy admission; this tile applies all eligible effects before collision-qualified capped fractional settlement, permits zero-fuel residual effects and skips a whole next tick when fuel is negative. Neither hurt nor use return proves actual displacement; no new credit for generic repel.

full_chain.observation: Native mod preInit prepares/registries register REPELLER block + ItemBlock, stone and vials; native init registers TileEntityRepeller. Bottom-half creation returns the ITickable, top-half interaction redirects to bottom. Actual block activation adds/removes stone, consumes Byariis vial input with fixed loss10 (server fuel mutation) and cycles 0..3 radius states on server empty-hand use. Actual filled-vial creative producer writes dynamic amounts; survival acquisition not researched.

ItemAspectContainer.fromItem reads blHerbloreAspects; AspectContainer.get sums dynamic/static storage and set invokes item onChanged write-through when changed. Refill uses added=min(maxFuel-fuel,amount-loss), then removes added+loss from noncreative vial or substitutes its empty container. Withdrawal returns min(fuel,5000) to new vial, but TileEntityRepeller.removeFuel subtracts the requested5000 rather than returned amount, so ordinary partial withdrawals can create negative fuel. Setter/client inventory operations are not all server guarded.

update first sets running from fuel>0 && hasShimmerstone, announcing transitions. Then fuel<0 clamps to0 and skips the entire entity/cost branch. Otherwise entity/cost branch runs even with fuel==0, running==false or missing stone. Hence nominal power qualification is not final control admission. The nested fuel>0/fuel<=0 branch is unreachable and does not pre-clamp zero.

Server query uses current radius+5 AABB, actual center=(block+.5,+1.15,+.5). IMob targets except EntityWight and IBLBoss pass only if nearest of eight AABB corners has squared distance strictly less than radius squared. Before billing, call move(PISTON,diffX*.1,0,diffZ*.1), overwrite motionX/Z with unit-from-pre-move-position times ((radius-len)/radius*1.5+.5), and attempt SLOWNESS10 amp6 on LivingBase. No hurt call or native knockback attribute query. Cost contribution only when collidedHorizontally is false after the move call; movement/potion acceptance is not returned as an authoritative result.

Independent if(IProjectile || EntityFireball), so mob exclusions do not globally guard this branch. Same corner gate, captures current speed then horizontal piston move and writes all motion components radial with that speed. IProjectile.shoot(radialUnit,1,1) follows and may replace the prior velocity; sets velocityChanged=true. Bills only if !collidedHorizontally && !collidedVertically && !onGround. No owner/acceleration/hit-set reset or impact cancel. Concrete/native shoot implementations not expanded; final speed/trajectory unproven.

After processing all sampled targets, accumulatedCost += min(sumCost,.00125)*1000. Mob contribution .00028*(radiusState/1.5+1); projectile .0004*(radiusState/1.5+1). While accumulatedCost>1 (strict), subtract1 and fuel--. No pre-effect affordability, lower clamp or per-target dedup. At ordinary bounded residual, a cap-hit tick can charge two integer fuel; a zero-fuel residual field can go negative after effects. Native block update flag3 only if fuel consumed; markDirty every nonnegative-fuel branch.

Both sides then reset deployTicks when prevRunning differs, set lastRadius and advance quintic easing. desiredRadius=4.5*(radiusState+1). Control already used the previous radius. Running extension feeds current radius as b and desiredRadius as c; stop/retraction feeds desiredRadius as b rather than the current operational radius, with c=-desiredRadius. Thus power-off residual radius is still operational, and stopping a partially deployed field can jump it near desired rather than shrink monotonically. No fixed 80-tick deployment-success claim because current radius is repeatedly fed back.

Full tile NBT writes fuel/stone/deployTicks/radius/running/radiusState/accumulatedCost and raw-reads them; prevRunning=running, lastRadius not restored. Explicit update packet writes operational fields but omits accumulatedCost; receiver applies them and sets prevRunning without lastRadius. getUpdateTag first calls super then writes fields; inherited super serialization is not expanded, so do not say the tag excludes accumulatedCost. No custom per-target effect receipt/identity sequence. Native packet dispatch timing and tick after tile removal unverified.

Actual ClientProxy binds RenderRepeller; isRunning returns running || radius>0, so render queues an interpolated sphere during residual phase, independent of any target effect/expense. ClientProxy registers WorldRenderHandler whose complete RenderWorldLast method consumes queued spheres via shader or fallback GL and clears the list on ordinary completion of that section. Shader enabled but unavailable nested resources need not fall back. Shine follows stone presence, model receives fuel ratio; neither is rejection proof. Directional render center is offset .12 from physical center. Independent block randomDisplayTick emits ambient animator paths. No actual model/texture assets read or changed.

Stopping power does not clear radius or cost residue immediately. As stop easing reaches nonpositive radius it clamps0 and subsequent strict radius gate excludes ordinary targets. Negative-fuel ticks skip effects but still evolve radius. Missing support/top/bottom drives block teardown and ordinary parent break call; drops stone and plain repeller without copying fuel in this block method. Native tile destruction/invalidation internals and graphical/runtime correctness are outside evidence.

critical_boundaries: Control write, cost eligibility, running flag, visible radius and successful displacement are separate facts. A free (collision-exempt) attempt can still overwrite velocity or add slowness; cost flags are not positive displacement receipts.

Current field control does not require positive fuel or stone; only negative fuel suppresses a whole effect tick. Fuel goes negative after effects; running may remain true until the next server update recalculates it.

Stopping a partially expanded field uses desiredRadius as easing base, so residual phase is not guaranteed monotonic from its previous radius. The stopped-field effect uses pre-easing radius, delaying a changed boundary one update.

The nearest-corner helper is not closest-point-on-box intersection. A box enclosing the sphere can be excluded if all corners are outside. Geometry and cost multipliers are helpers, no separate credit.

No guard for len==0 in radial normalization. If entity position lies sufficiently outside despite a near corner inside, mob computed speed can be negative. Do not claim all accepted targets always move outward or all projectiles are stopped.

IProjectile.shoot happens after the nominal old-speed radial assignment. No claim of speed preservation, acceleration clearing, attribution transfer, impact veto, or exact server-to-client movement convergence.
IBLBoss/EntityWight exemption covers IMob branch only; no complete type membership inventory. No target-state/ally/native damage gate, no attempt UUID or feedback throttle.

Integer charge threshold is strict >1; binary floating-point contributions can affect boundary observations. Cap limits newly accumulated cost per effect tick, not total cumulative debt for malformed loaded state. Raw saved accumulatedCost/fuel/radius/state are unvalidated.

addFuel accepts negative nonzero requests if capacity permits; actual refill producer supplies amount-loss>=0. removeFuel subtracts requested rather than returned amount. These are source observations, not fixes applied to either project.

Stone insert/remove and withdrawal inventory consequences are not all explicitly server-only, unlike server control branch. Do not claim transaction atomicity, no prediction duplication, or exploit reproduction.

Client state easing runs independently between packets; onDataPacket does not reset lastRadius and sets prevRunning=running. No complete packet ordering/late-join interpolation verification. getUpdateTag super may serialize more fields than explicit override writes.

REPELLER_SHIELDS.clear is ordinary control flow, not a finally-protected global cleanup guarantee. Shader/render helper internals, native packet transport, native move/attribute/slowness application and runtime/graphics remain unverified.

No denial text, target flash or rejection sound is produced by the core ticker. Ambient sphere/particles, comparator fuel display and stone shine are state cues only. No Dynasty UI or new ordinary-constitution gray text added.
